source.english_context: Unit 21 Haircuts, Salons, and Personal Care Goal: make simple grooming appointments and describe what you want. Daily Life English I would like a haircut. Please trim just a little. Can I make an appointment for Saturday? How much does it cost? Do you take walk-ins today? How long is the wait? I would like to keep the length. Could you cut about one inch off? Please leave my bangs a little longer. Can you make it look like this photo? Is shampoo included in the price? I have a sensitive scalp. Could you use less styling product? Can I see the back in the mirror? May I book my next appointment now? Vocabulary barber a person who cuts short hair, often men's hair salon a place for hair, nails, or beauty services trim cut a small amount bangs hair cut across the front of the face appointment a planned time for a service walk-in a customer without an appointment shampoo a product used to wash hair conditioner a product used to make hair softer and easier to comb scalp the skin on your head under your hair layers sections of hair cut to different lengths styling product a product used to shape or hold a hairstyle blow-dry dry and style hair with a hair dryer US Customs Photos help. Show a picture of the haircut or style you want. Some places accept walk-ins, but appointments are safer when you have limited time. Many people tip for hair and beauty services. Check the final price before deciding. Before the service starts, explain how much hair you want removed. A picture and a length in inches can help. Ask whether washing, drying, or styling is included in the quoted price. Extra services may be priced separately at some salons. If the stylist suggests a change, ask them to explain it before agreeing. It is fine to request your original plan. If you cannot keep an appointment, contact the salon as early as possible and ask about its cancellation or rescheduling policy. Dialogue Student: Hi, do you take walk-ins? Stylist: Yes. What would you like today? Student: Just a trim, please. About one inch. Stylist: No problem. Do you want layers? Student: No, thank you. Same style, just shorter. Stylist: Would you like to show me a picture of the length? Student: Yes. I would like it to look like this. Stylist: I understand. The trim is twenty-eight dollars without a wash. Student: That works for me. Could you leave the front a little longer? Stylist: Certainly. I will show you the length before I start.

japanese_explanation.heading: 写真と短い表現が役に立つ
points: ヘアカットでは、長さやスタイルを英語だけで説明するのは難しいことがあります。写真を見せると安全です。
walk-in は予約なしの客です。ただし待ち時間が長いこともあるので、時間が限られている時は予約しましょう。
髪、ネイル、美容サービスではチップを渡す人が多いです。最終料金を見てから判断して大丈夫です。

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 照片和短句很有帮助
points: 剪头发时，只用英文解释长度和发型可能很难。给对方看照片会更安全。
walk-in 指没有预约的客人。不过可能要等很久，所以时间紧时最好预约。
头发、美甲和美容服务通常有人给小费。可以看最后价格后再决定。

ja.heading: 写真と短い表現が役に立つ
points: ヘアカットでは、長さやスタイルを英語だけで説明するのは難しいことがあります。写真を見せると安全です。
「walk-in」は予約なしの客です。ただし待ち時間が長いこともあるので、時間が限られている時は予約しましょう。
髪、ネイル、美容サービスではチップを渡す人が多いです。最終料金を見てから判断して大丈夫です。

ko.heading: 사진과 간단한 표현이 도움이 됩니다
points: 헤어컷을 할 때 길이와 스타일을 영어로만 설명하는 것은 어려울 수 있습니다. 사진을 보여주는 것이 안전합니다.
「walk-in」은 예약 없이 방문하는 손님을 의미합니다. 대기 시간이 길 수 있으므로, 시간이 제한적일 때는 예약하는 것이 좋습니다.
헤어, 네일, 미용 서비스에서는 팁을 주는 경우가 많습니다. 최종 요금을 확인한 후 결정해도 괜찮습니다.

zh-Hans.heading: 照片和短语很有帮助
points: 理发时，只用英语解释长度和发型可能会很困难。出示照片会更安全。
“walk-in”指没有预约的顾客。但是等待时间可能会很长，所以当您时间有限时，最好提前预约。
头发、美甲和美容服务通常会给小费。您可以查看最终价格后再决定。

es.heading: Las fotos y las frases cortas son útiles
points: Para un corte de pelo, puede ser difícil explicar la longitud o el estilo solo en inglés. Es seguro mostrar una foto.
Un «walk-in» es un cliente sin cita previa. Sin embargo, el tiempo de espera puede ser largo, así que si tiene tiempo limitado, es mejor hacer una cita.
Muchas personas dan propina por los servicios de peluquería y belleza. Está bien decidir después de revisar el precio final.

pt-BR.heading: Fotos e frases curtas são úteis
points: Para um corte de cabelo, pode ser difícil descrever o comprimento ou o estilo apenas em inglês. É seguro mostrar uma foto.
Um "walk-in" é um cliente sem agendamento. No entanto, o tempo de espera pode ser longo, então se você tiver tempo limitado, é melhor agendar um horário.
Muitas pessoas dão gorjetas para serviços de cabelo, unhas e beleza. Você pode decidir depois de verificar o preço final.

fr.heading: Les photos et les expressions courtes sont utiles
points: Pour une coupe de cheveux, il peut être difficile d'expliquer la longueur ou le style uniquement en anglais. Il est sûr de montrer une photo.
Un « walk-in » est un client sans rendez-vous. Cependant, le temps d'attente peut être long, donc si vous avez peu de temps, il est préférable de prendre rendez-vous.
Beaucoup de gens donnent des pourboires pour les services de coiffure, d'ongles et de beauté. Vous pouvez décider après avoir vérifié le prix final.

de.heading: Fotos und kurze Ausdrücke sind hilfreich
points: Bei einem Haarschnitt kann es schwierig sein, die Länge oder den Stil nur auf Englisch zu beschreiben. Es ist sicherer, ein Foto zu zeigen.
Ein „walk-in“ ist ein Kunde ohne Termin. Da die Wartezeiten jedoch lang sein können, sollten Sie einen Termin vereinbaren, wenn Ihre Zeit begrenzt ist.
Viele Leute geben Trinkgeld für Haar-, Nagel- und Kosmetikdienstleistungen. Es ist in Ordnung, erst nach Überprüfung des Endpreises zu entscheiden.
